semantic.source:
import Base
type Cell is Data:
  Leaf{flag: Bool}
  Nest{cell: Cell}
type Wide is Data:
  C0{cell: Cell, flag: Bool}
  C1{cell: Cell, flag: Bool}
type Partition is Data:
  P0{cell: Cell}
  P1{cell: Cell}
def matrix(wide: Wide, partition: Partition) -> Nat:
  match wide partition:
    case C0{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}, True{}} P0{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}}:
      1n
    case C1{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}, True{}} P0{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}}:
      2n
    case _ P0{Nest{Nest{Leaf{False{}}}}}:
      32n
    case _ P0{_}:
      33n
    case C0{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}, True{}} P1{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}}:
      3n
    case C1{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}, True{}} P1{Nest{Nest{Leaf{True{}}}}}:
      4n
    case _ P1{Nest{Nest{Leaf{False{}}}}}:
      32n
    case _ P1{_}:
      33n
    case _ _:
      34n
